image_description: The image displays two traffic light units suspended from overhead wires against a cloudy sky and a modern building facade. The primary subject is the left-hand unit, which is illuminated with a red light at the top. It features a vertical black housing with three circular lenses, each equipped with a protruding visor/hood. The right-hand unit is unlit, angled away from the camera, showing its side profile and mounting arm. Overhead catenary wires and a street lamp structure are visible in the background.
